name: Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited
about: Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited manufactures and sells sugar in India. It operates through Sugar and Cogeneration segments. The company is involved in the provision of bagasse and molasses; and cogeneration of power. It also exports its products. Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited was formerly known as SPB Sugars and Chemicals Limited and changed its name to Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited in January 2000. Ponni Sugars (Erode) Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Chennai, India.
